explanation: The theorem says that `quotientPi_aux.toFun p`, an auxiliary definition in the same file, is additive. `toFun p` is by definition `quotientPiLift p (fun i => (p i).mkQ) _`. The proof is just `LinearMap.map_add` applied to that linear map. That is the generic homomorphism law applied to the library's own definition, which the criteria exclude. I read the file and found no other Mathlib declaration that states additivity of this specific map. The only other candidates are the library's own `map_smul` and `quotientPi`, which don't count.
